reason: I already count calories in another app, and in our house my mother and the helper run the kitchen, not me and not a phone. Scanning receipts and inviting people to a list is one more chore I won't keep up.
objection: My mother / my helper manages the kitchen, not an app. I'd be the only one using it, so the shared list and reminders would sit empty after a week.
would_change_my_mind: If my helper could just snap the receipt and it worked in Arabic without me doing anything, and the nutrition part replaced my current calorie tracker for free.
